title: Video by thebankhesit
description:
💰 You just robbed a bank. $4,200,000 in cash.

🚨 The cops are closing in, your partner is missing, and someone has betrayed you.

Now your survival depends on ONE decision.

🚗 A – Get in your partner’s car.
🏃 B – Trust no one and escape alone.

👇 Comment A or B to decide what happens in Part 2!
